text:
alex: Hey team — holding off on merging the tango branch (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/core/pull/24677) until CI stabilizes. Integration tests are spiking and there's a DB migration scheduled at 18:00 UTC. Can people give eyes and advise canary timing? :eyes:

maria: Thanks for the heads-up. From the CI logs it looks like the kafka integration testcase is timing out — `Consumer did not join group within 30s`. Can you paste the failing call/site?

alex: It's coming from our consumer start path — calling `waitForConsumer()`; pushed a quick tweak to increase join timeout, see latest commit on the branch.

sam: FYI CI queue is a bit backed up right now, ~8 pending on stripe-x runner. If we rerun it'll likely sit ~10-15m. Rebase onto main (infra fix) would help.

ci-bot: build #24677.1 started — running integration suite

ci-bot: build #24677.1 failed — timeout in kafka_consumer_test (stdout: "Consumer did not join group within 30s")

julie: I can watch a canary after the DB window (18:30 UTC). If you deploy a canary with small traffic weight and a smoke check I'll approve once smoke passes.

alex: pushed quick timeout bump, PR updated (changed join timeout to 60s). Snippet: `consumer.join(timeout=60)` — please eyeballs.

maria: Do you want me to rebase and force-push, or merge main into branch? I can do the rebase if you prefer to keep history tidy.

sam: Rebase is my +1 too. After that we should `ci-bot rerun` so it gets into the new queue slot.

alex: Let's avoid shipping before the DB migration completes. Proposal: schedule merge for 19:00 UTC, canary at 18:35. ops-bot, is there any more detail on the maintenance window?

ops-bot: Reminder: DB schema migration in prod starts 18:00 UTC, expected ~45m. Read-only fallback will be enabled at 18:45 UTC.

julie: That window works. I'll standby for the 18:35 canary and give +1 after a quick smoke. tagging @maria @sam

maria: I'll kick a CI re-run at 18:20 UTC and post results here.

sam: If CI still backs off, fallback plan is to cut a hotfix branch and do manual deploy steps. Hoping we don't need that.

alex: Thanks all — scheduling merge for 19:00 if green. Ping me in-thread with any blockers or if canary fails. :thumbsup:
